# OopsFee

> OopsFee is an accountability app for iOS and Android that makes you put money where your mouth is: you make a promise, stake real money on it, and complete it with proof before the deadline — or lose the stake.

OopsFee is built on loss aversion: losing $25 hurts more than gaining $25 feels good. Willpower alone rarely works because there are no consequences for breaking promises to yourself; OopsFee adds a real financial consequence.

## How it works

1. Make your promise: type it or record it with your voice, pick a deadline, and choose how you will prove completion.
2. Set your stakes: for example $5, $25 or $100 — whatever is uncomfortable enough to make you follow through.
3. Prove it or lose it: complete with photo proof, friend verification, or health data. No proof by the deadline means the stake is lost.

## Features

- Voice commitment: record yourself making the promise and hear your own voice if you try to quit.
- Photo proof: take a real photo at completion (no gallery picks).
- Friend verification: assign a friend as a witness who confirms whether you did it.
- The Graveyard: every broken promise gets a tombstone showing how long it lasted and how much was lost.
- Escalating stakes: after a failed promise the next one costs 2x, then 4x.
- Reminders and notifications that get more pointed as the deadline approaches.
- Sponsor my failure: share a promise and friends can add money to your stake.
- "I told you so": friends write a roast message you only see if you fail.
- Friend activity, leaderboards, and iOS and Android home-screen widgets.
- Sign in with email, Apple, or Google. Payment methods are handled with Stripe; payouts via PayPal or card.

## Key facts

- Platforms: iOS and Android mobile app (the website is a marketing and legal site).
- Users must be at least 18 years old and have a valid payment method to use stakes.
- Fees: OopsFee may charge service fees for some transactions (for example wallet withdrawals); applicable fees are disclosed before the transaction.
- Website: https://oopsfee.app
- Support: support@oopsfee.app · Privacy: privacy@oopsfee.app · Legal: legal@oopsfee.app
